description: This is a test source file for a Python project that tests functions related to time budget analysis, Cohen's kappa, and Needleman-Wunsch identity methods within the 'irr' module of a Boris project. The file contains test cases using pytest for verifying behavior of similarity and agreement metrics between observations derived from database data.

classes.name: Test_irr
classes.description: Test class containing multiple unit tests for functions in the 'irr' module, focusing on Cohen's kappa and Needleman-Wunsch identity calculations.

methods.name: test_cohen_kappa_same_observation(self)
methods.description: Tests Cohen's kappa correctness when comparing the same observation twice, expecting a value of 1.

methods.name: test_cohen_kappa_very_different_obs(self)
methods.description: Tests Cohen's kappa when comparing very different observations, expecting a low or negative value.

methods.name: test_cohen_kappa_very_similar_obs_interval_state_1s(self)
methods.description: Tests Cohen's kappa on very similar observations with a 1-second interval, expecting a high value (close to 1).

methods.name: test_cohen_kappa_very_similar_obs_interval_state_3s(self)
methods.description: Tests Cohen's kappa with different interval states, expecting a perfect score of 1.

methods.name: test_cohen_kappa_very_similar_obs_interval_point_1s(self)
methods.description: Tests Cohen's kappa with a 0.1s interval, expecting a specific value around 0.866.

methods.name: test_cohen_kappa_very_similar_obs_interval_point_3s(self)
methods.description: Tests Cohen's kappa with a 0.3s interval, expecting a value around 0.798.

methods.name: test_obs_without_events(self)
methods.description: Tests Cohen's kappa when one observation has no events, expecting a value of -100.

methods.name: test_needleman_wunsch_identity_same_observation(self)
methods.description: Tests Needleman-Wunsch identity score for identical observations, expecting 100% similarity.

methods.name: test_needleman_wunsch_identity_very_different_obs(self)
methods.description: Tests Needleman-Wunsch identity score for very different observations, expecting about 85.84%.

methods.name: test_needleman_wunsch_identity_very_similar_obs_state_1s(self)
methods.description: Tests identity for very similar observation with 1s interval, expecting around 99.37%.

methods.name: test_needleman_wunsch_identity_very_similar_obs_state_3s(self)
methods.description: Tests identity for very similar observation with 3s interval, expecting 100%.

methods.name: test_needleman_wunsch_identity_very_similar_obs_point_1s(self)
methods.description: Tests identity for very similar observation at 0.1s, expecting about 99.30%.

methods.name: test_needleman_wunsch_identity_very_similar_obs_point_3s(self)
methods.description: Tests identity for very similar observation at 3s, expecting about 97.92%.
